scripts.clean:sdk: bun run clean:sdk:js && bun run clean:sdk:go
scripts.generate:sdk:js: bun run clean:sdk:js && cd apps/api && openapi-generator-cli generate -i docs/openapi.yaml -g typescript-fetch -o ../../sdk/core/js --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,npmName=@omnibase/core-js
scripts.generate:sdk:go: bun run clean:sdk:go && cd apps/api && openapi-generator-cli generate -i docs/openapi.yaml -g go -o ../../sdk/core/go --additional-properties=packageName=omnibase --git-user-id=phoenixsolutionsgroup --git-repo-id=omnibase/sdk/core/go
scripts.generate:sdk: bun run generate:openapi && bun run generate:sdk:js && bun run generate:sdk:go
scripts.test:api:contract:spec: bun run test:api:contract:setup && (source $PWD/tests/api/contract/.test-env && cd tests/api/contract && schemathesis run ../../../apps/api/docs/openapi.yaml --report junit,har --report-dir ./test-reports; EXIT_CODE=$?; bun run test:api:cleanup; exit $EXIT_CODE)
scripts.test:api:contract: bun run test:api:contract:spec && bun run test:api:contract:results
scripts.test:api:performance: bun run build:k6 && export $(grep -v '^#' ./tests/api/k6/.env | xargs) && k6 run --vus 100 --duration 30s --out cloud ./tests/api/k6/dist/index.js
scripts.test:api:integration: bun run build:k6 && export $(grep -v '^#' ./tests/api/k6/.env | xargs) && k6 run --out cloud ./tests/api/k6/dist/index.js
scripts.test:api:integration:local: bun run build:k6 && export $(grep -v '^#' ./tests/api/k6/.env | xargs) && k6 run ./tests/api/k6/dist/index.js
